questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: In Schedule 02 Question 1: Consider a car moving on a circular banked road of radius R = 10 m at banking angle theta. Neglecting friction, what is the optimum speed for no skidding?
questions.solution: The horizontal component of normal reaction N*sin(theta) provides centripetal force m*v^2/R and N*cos(theta) = mg, giving v = sqrt(R*g*tan(theta)).
questions.sourceLocator: NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch 05 Sections & Exercises

questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: In Schedule 02 Question 36: A block of mass m = 38 kg rests on a rough horizontal surface with coefficient of static friction mu_s = 0.4. What minimum horizontal force in Newtons is required to start motion? (Take g = 10 m/s^2).
questions.solution: Limiting static friction is f_s(max) = mu_s * m * g = 0.4 * 38 * 10 = 152 N.
questions.sourceLocator: NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch 05 Sections & Exercises
